works: A large GeoJSON whose question covers only the first part is answered on the prefix routes, with words that say so.

design.question: streamed-question-model.ts: questionInventory reads the item's pinned provisional generation (number and hash must match); streamedQuestionBody builds streamed-prefix-mapping/1 with prefix pins from that generation, or streamed-mapping/1 when sealed.
design.routes: streamed-queries.ts: useStreamedGeneration reads the immutable generation once; authorStreamedLayout and approveStreamedLayout choose prefix-recipes or recipes by plan version.
design.command: useLayoutCommand.ts (added to OWN by the lead): approval routed by isStreamedPlan, so a prefix receipt approves on its prefix route. layout-command.ts: LayoutBody includes the prefix body.
design.review: layout-model.ts (added to OWN by the lead): prefix receipts read like sealed ones plus 'Taken from the first N features read', N from the receipt's prefix.recordsSeen. question-model.ts: choicesFromRecipe reads prefix receipts.
design.words: First part: 'This layout is taken from the first N features read. The rest of the file is checked against it as it arrives, and packages follow when the whole file is read and checked.' (N = layoutProfile.recordsSeen). Re-ask: the item's own limitReason in a warning banner.

acceptance: A provisional question posts POST .../prefix-recipes then .../prefix-recipes/{id}/approve through the Studio's useLayoutCommand; the body passes the published prefix author schema.
A sealed question still posts .../recipes then .../recipes/{id}/approve.
A prefix receipt approves on the prefix route, and its review lines name kind, identifier and the first-N line, not 'not supplied'.
The panel shows the prefix words and the field choices from the pinned generation; a generation whose hash differs opens no choices.
A re-ask over the sealed profile shows the item's changed-field words.

inputs.good: LR3 sealed Niagara inventory counts (existing test source), read as a test_only first part
inputs.note: Code only; no runtime, provider or Docker.

gaps: The server's re-ask words do not name the changed field and the item and profile state none, so the Studio cannot name it.

scan.result: 218 added lines in apps/studio/src; no candidates

checkedNoIssue: One primary action: the existing 'Use this layout' button; no new button.
The disabled primary keeps its reason: the summary line above it, unchanged.
Banners use the existing Banner tones (warning for the re-ask, danger for read errors); no new CSS or tokens.
No mono for field names; light only; no theme code.
Every number shown is read from the item or receipt (layoutProfile.recordsSeen, prefix.recordsSeen); no sample values.

next: The lead merges into task/int3-pre. No producer changed, so no pins need regenerating.
If the officer must see which field changed, the server would need to state it on the item (outside this task).
